title: Breast Augmentation vs Breast Lift: Which Do You Need?
meta_description: A lift raises breasts that have dropped; implants add size. How to tell which you need, when to combine them, and how scars, recovery and cost compare.
excerpt: A breast lift and a breast augmentation fix different things. Here is how to tell which one you need, when the two are combined, and how scars, recovery and price compare.
quick_answer:
Do I need a breast lift or a breast augmentation?

It depends on what bothers you. The American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS) says a lift doesn't significantly change size, and that augmentation doesn't correct severely drooping breasts. If your breasts sag and you also want more fullness, ASPS says you may need a lift along with an augmentation.

images.text_in_image:
Breast lift vs breast augmentation

Breast lift
Changes: position and shape
Size: doesn't significantly change
Surgery time: about 1 to 3 hours
Back to work: desk work at about 1 week

Breast augmentation
Changes: size and upper fullness
Size: larger
Surgery time: one to several hours
Back to work: a few days to a week
Implants are not lifetime devices

Sources: ASPS, Cleveland Clinic, The Aesthetic Society, FDA
